Jane Eyre.look: Eighteen, small and slight, plain pale face, dark hair smoothed flat, in a plain dove-grey silk dress with a single pearl brooch; quiet, watchful.

Edward Rochester.look: Mid-thirties, broad-chested, dark hair, a heavy dark face with a square forehead and black brows, resting on a couch with a bandaged ankle.

Mrs. Fairfax.look: A elderly widow in a black gown, white cap and apron, small and kind, knitting.

Adèle.look: A French girl of about eight, curly dark ringlets, a rose-coloured silk frock, a little white sash, bright and talkative.

scenes.title: Tea in the drawing-room: Rochester questions Jane
scenes.place: The drawing-room at Thornfield Hall on a snowy winter evening: a bright fire, a lit chandelier, a couch by the hearth where Mr. Rochester reclines, a tea-table and a small table with a portfolio.
